RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

For a department head position, leadership and management credentials often carry greater weight than technical research degrees like a PhD. The successful candidate’s formal management training and broad leadership experience offer a clear, job-relevant basis for the decision. 

An all-female panel is common in healthcare and clinical laboratory administration and is not evidence of bias. Raising the panel's gender without documented procedural flaws or discriminatory remarks will be seen as an unfounded accusation, which could severely damage your professional reputation and future advancement within the hospital. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up asking strictly for constructive feedback on how you can strengthen your profile for future leadership opportunities.
